conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth.

balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, aiming for ~2.5% monthly. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns and steady growth.
